constraints: Only separately frozen painted-trail response parameters may be estimated from the P1 response target.
Baseline locomotion and all H2/H3/H4/H5 path-history parameters remain fixed and may not be refit.
The same painted-trail response parameter set must be used for both short and long approach-history strata.
Treatment-specific or path-specific pheromone-response parameters are forbidden.
Response fitting must use pheromone-vs-DCM treatment contrasts within each path-length stratum so response parameters cannot absorb the unresolved short-vs-long baseline locomotion structure.
Primary response observables are middle_zone_fraction and trail_axis_exit.
Secondary guard observables are time_to_exit_s and beeline_mm.
Average_Speed_Moving, Traveled_Dist_Moving, Straightness, Prop_time_moving, Average_Speed and Traveled_Dist are forbidden fitting targets.
Development tools may write reports only and may not update a canonical model file.
The Poissonnier 2026 Y-maze remains inaccessible to fitting, candidate ranking, stopping rules and model selection.
